SELECT a.id, a.s_mail, a.title, a.email_body, a.link ,b.ten_mail as ten_s_mail, b.username_smail, c.ten_mail as ten_r_mail, b.mk_mail, b.smtp_server, b.smtp_port, b.type_smail, a.r_mail
FROM smailct a
	LEFT JOIN dmsmail b on a.s_mail = b.s_mail
	LEFT JOIN dmrmail c on a.r_mail = c.r_mail
WHERE id = @id
